description:
NLB Services is seeking a Digital Personalization Manager to lead the design and execution of personalization technology that enhances customer experience. This role involves collaborating with stakeholders to optimize digital journeys and manage segmentation and targeting efforts.

Drive business results and provide strategic guidance by leading the design, development and execution of personalization technology

Support the development and refinement of digital journeys across the web and app world

Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to identify use cases and enable targeting of key audience segments both on and offsite

Lead Digital Personalization (Segmentation & Targeting) and Optimization (A/B, MVT website testing) efforts

Act as a subject matter expert and help envision, sell in, and build the platform of the future for the Company

Provide forward thinking and insightful analysis and manage personalization roadmap
